json.rationale: This is a crossroads with no sign, light or marking regulating priority, and both roads are paved. The default rule is to yield (ceda el paso) only to vehicles approaching from your right (prioridad a la derecha). As no road users are in sight, there is nobody to give way to and you may proceed.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: You must stop and yield (ceda el paso) and wait even though the junction is completely empty.
json.whyWrong: The rule only requires yielding to vehicles actually approaching from the right. With no vehicle coming from the right there is nobody to give way to, so waiting is not required.
